label: Provideam fetch
info: Calls the Provideam report API every day and writes the source day files of the PBI report build tabs. Needs the Config tab.

name: [1] TRIGGERS & FETCH SETTINGS
info: STAGE 1 - TRIGGERS AND FETCH SETTINGS. The clock runs every day at 07:00 UTC and fetches the last 3 production days (DAYS_BACK in 1.1, again every day so late corrections arrive). Backfill: edit the inject payload {"start":"YYYY-MM-DD","end":"YYYY-MM-DD"} (production days, optional "sites") and click it; the Run monitor sends the same through the link in BACKFILL. 1.1 is the only node to edit: sites, days, dry run (true by default: nothing is written and no build starts). The API key is in 1.1 CONFIG of the Config tab. 1.1 sends one task per day, site and report type (plan OPT, run rates, line losses, loss correction).

name: 1.1 FETCH SETTINGS (edit here)
[2] CALLS
info: STAGE 2 - one message per task, one every 2 s (Provideam answers in 1 to 7 s; a day of one site and type is at most about 1.3 MB). 1 sets the body file <root>/reference/provideam_reports/site=<Site>/<type>.json (the saved report body, its machines and, for the correction, the loss groups the export keeps), the read node loads it, 2 puts the day in it and builds the POST with the API key of 1.1 CONFIG, 3 turns the answer into the CSV text of the SharePoint export. A missing body file stops the task without an error (read node): the run then waits for the join timeout and the log shows the lost call.

name: 2.1 Set body file
2.2 Build Provideam request
2.3 Make source CSV
[3] WRITE SOURCE FILE
info: STAGE 3 - the day file <root>/pbi_report/source/<type>/site=<Site>/<type>_<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv. A rerun of the day replaces it.

name: [4] RUN DONE
info: STAGE 4 - the join collects the task results and sends when the last task arrives (or after 10 minutes, if a call was lost). 1 counts them and builds the job {sites, days}: a day is built when every type of a site came back. The wait gives the last writes 30 s, then the job goes to the link in BACKFILL of PBI report build and PBI report build 2 (connect the two link outs after import). The build tabs list the source folder and read only the files that exist.

name: 4.1 Build the build job
[5] ERRORS
info: STAGE 5 - a catch node takes every error raised by a node of this tab and turns it into a log line with the name of the node and the message of the API (for example the limit message of evaluateKPIs). Errors of the log nodes themselves are not logged again.

name: 5.1 Describe error
[6] LOG
info: STAGE 6 - every log line arrives here through the link "to LOG". 1 turns a line into a row (time, flow, site, production day, level) and shows it in the debug sidebar. The join collects the rows for 30 s, the delay lets one batch pass every 10 s so two writes do not overlap, 3 sets the file of the month and the read node loads the old file. A read of a file that does not exist answers nothing (only a warning), so the same batch also goes through a 10 s wait to the append step. The log is written whatever the dry-run switch says.

name: 6.1 Format log line
6.2 Note last log line
6.3 Build log write
[7] LOG WRITE
info: STAGE 7 - adds the rows of the batch to the old file and writes the whole file back (the data lake has no append). Columns: ts_utc, seq, flow, site, production_day, mode, level, source, message. Every field is quoted, line breaks become a space. The batch arrives twice (read answer and the wait) and is written once. If the read gives no answer for a file this flow wrote before, a new file with a time stamp is written, so the history is never replaced.

name: 7.1 Append log rows
